answer: A remote attestation quotes the enclave code before the identity is allowed to act, and the chain groups identities by quoted measurement, so a farm running one image in one fleet collapses into a single counted voter. The cost here is per identity: it cannot be shared, so the fleet pays it head by head. The pearl is the quoted measurement, the inlet the group it forms, and the jetty the voice that group is worth; the pearl and the inlet collapse a farm, while only a fresh jetty of hardware escapes the grouping.
